paymentLink.title: Payment linking
paymentLink.intro: Choose which document the Payment-In and Payment-Out screens reconcile money against. In estimate mode the estimate is treated as the bill and posts to the party's ledger.

ewayBillSettings.title: E-Way Bill Portal
ewayBillSettings.intro: Enter your NIC e-way bill API credentials to generate e-way bills directly on the government portal.
ewayBillSettings.howTo: Create these on ewaybillgst.gov.in → Registration → For GSP (select the GSP, set an API username and password). Without them, e-way bill generation is disabled.

einvoiceSettings.title: E-Invoice Portal
einvoiceSettings.intro: Enter your NIC e-invoice (IRP) API credentials to file IRNs directly on the government portal under your own GSTIN.
einvoiceSettings.howTo: Create these on einvoice1.gst.gov.in → API Registration (map the GSP, set an API username and password). Without them, live e-invoice generation is disabled.

help.hsn: Harmonized System of Nomenclature — the product classification code GST law requires on invoices. Your CA or the GST portal can tell you the right code for each product.
help.gstRate: The tax slab for this item (0, 0.25, 3, 5, 12, 18 or 28%). Applied automatically on every invoice line.
help.reorderLevel: When stock on hand falls to or below this quantity, the item is flagged LOW STOCK on the dashboard and stock report.
help.barcode: EAN/UPC or your own code. USB scanners type it — scan into any search box to find the item instantly.
help.trackBatches: Purchases must name a batch (with optional expiry); sales pick which batch to sell from. Expiring batches raise alerts and expired ones cannot be sold.
help.textile: Textile attributes — optional, shown on items where set.

hero.badge: AI-powered business ERP · 3 months free · GST-first
hero.subtitle: RGS is an AI-powered ERP for Indian businesses — voice-based voucher entry, an AI accounting assistant, GST filing, WhatsApp invoices, inventory and payroll, all on real double-entry books. Start with a 3-month free trial.

features.title: Everything to run your business, with AI built in

voice.title: Voice-based voucher entry
voice.body: Speak your sales, purchases and payments — RGS turns your voice into accurate double-entry vouchers in seconds.

aiAssistant.title: AI accounting assistant
aiAssistant.body: Ask plain-language questions about your books and get instant answers, summaries and insights from your live data.

gstFiling.title: GST filing support
gstFiling.body: GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B computed live from your books with HSN summaries and input-tax credit — export-ready for your CA.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp invoices
whatsapp.body: Send invoices and payment reminders to your customers on WhatsApp the moment you bill them.

inventory.title: Inventory management
inventory.body: Stock moves with every sale and purchase — weighted-average valuation, batches, reorder levels and low-stock alerts.

payroll.title: Payroll automation
payroll.body: Run employee payroll with salary components and payslips that post straight to your books.

multiCompany.title: Multi-company support
multiCompany.body: Manage multiple companies and branches from one login, each with its own books, GST and team.

deployment.title: Cloud + local server deployment
deployment.body: Run RGS in the cloud or on your own server with a single Docker command — your data, your choice.

why.title: Desktop software wasn’t built for how you work today
why.body: Your accountant is in one city, your branch in another, and your CA needs the books at filing time. RGS puts everyone on the same live books — with the role-based guardrails an audit demands.

everywhere.title: Works everywhere
everywhere.body: Any browser, any device. Nothing to install on client machines.

correct.title: Accountant-correct
correct.body: Vouchers are immutable — cancel, never delete. Full audit trail.

noLockIn.title: No vendor lock-in
noLockIn.body: Self-hosted with open APIs. Your data never leaves your control.

notes.issueNoteHelp: A credit note reverses part of a sales invoice (goods returned / post-sale discount) and reduces your GST liability. A debit note reverses part of a purchase bill and reduces your input tax credit.

parties.openingHelp: Amount already owed when you start using RGS. For customers this is a receivable (debit); for vendors a payable (credit).
